figures_added.what: Sale price tag showing '£20' and '25% OFF' on a soft-amber tag with a hole punch. Satisfies show-what-you-say for the opener's £20 T-shirt scenario. Theme-safe (currentColor strokes/text, fill-opacity fill), self-contained, <1KB, role=img + aria-label.

notes: Percentages is a textual topic: the exam prints no figure for 'increase £350 by 12%' or reverse/compound calculations, so no per-problem figures were added (exam-realism test). The only printable scene is the opener's sale tag, which is drawn. All problem displays are pure LaTeX calculations with no described shapes/graphs/tables.
